paras: In Lakeshire, Martie Jainrose tends a garden beside Lake Everstill. She gathers herbs and flowers for the town while wild beasts threaten her plots, and she seems fond of Guard Parker.

Martie Jainrose tends herbs and flowers for Lakeshire as its herbalist. Blackrock orcs, gnolls, and local brigands threaten the Redridge Mountains, but Martie keeps the town supplied with fresh herbs and floral arrangements. Wild animals disrupt her work, especially Bellygrub, a monstrous boar that often ravages her garden beds. Martie also seems fond of Guard Parker. Parker is courting Darcy, who calls Martie a jealous rival.
